items.title: Space Industry Needs Economic Infrastructure Says Nebex CEO

Bhatia compared the potential of a space economy to the role of American Express and Wells Fargo at the beginning of the railroad industry.

items.title: Coca-Cola Stock Pops After Earnings Shine a Light on Consumer Spending
items.summary: Coca-Cola  stock rose Tuesday after the soft drinks company reported better-than-expected earnings and raised its full-year guidance, signaling to investors that demand for fizzy drinks remains robust.  Coca-Cola reported adjusted earnings of 97 cents a share, as revenue jumped 7% from a year ago to $13.4 billion.  Analysts were expecting earnings of 93 cents a share on revenue of $13.2 billion, according to a FactSet poll.

overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 70.37% annualised against 24.57% volatility (Sharpe 2.11) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 41.0%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.37% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.11% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -12.42%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.
